changes: Separate trim, legacy render extent and atlas sample rectangle
Separate immutable texture keys from dynamic material state
Explicit remap shade and coverage channels; no generic engine-native color promise
schemaChange.migration: No runtime consumes v1 or v2. Reject unknown versions; do not auto-convert.

source.hashMeaning: SHA-256 of the canonical synthetic descriptor, not an existing SHP file
source.productionBinding: Replace kind/member/hash with the resolved original member bytes and theater; verify frame metadata against decoded source.

selection.algorithm: Use one explicitly selected immutable pack. Try requested density, then lower supported HD density. Validate complete member before activation; otherwise original. Never merge packs or select by directory order.
selection.packSwitch: Between games only; dispose old pack allocations.

logical.unit: original SHP pixel before existing world scale
logical.anchorMeaning: Existing builder canvas-center plus caller offset, represented explicitly; synthetic anchor includes caller offset. Never add a second anchor translation.
logical.legacyPadding: TextureAtlas rounds odd frame width and height up to even. Preserve that existing render extent, keeping extra texels transparent.
logical.geometry: Use legacyRenderSize, original offsets/align/depth/world scale for positions. Use sampleRect/page size for UVs. Pixel split = logical split * density.
logical.animation: Original frame selection, facing and timing. No new frame interpolation.
logical.simulation: No camera, tile, foundation, hit-test or simulation-bound changes.

baseTexture.rgb: sRGB; decode to linear before shading
baseTexture.alpha: straight coverage, unassociated; upload without premultiplication

dataTexture.B: 0 = existing caller lighting; any other value unsupported and rejects member

color.rampFormula: For each owner RGB byte: floor(ownerChannel / 255 * factor * 4), then the same palette color-space path as 1x.
color.shading: Mix linear base RGB and owner-remapped palette RGB using R/255. Multiply by 1+extraLight then clamp; preserve vertex color multipliers and existing instance/uniform opacity, alpha-test and render pass. Parity must be proved before art integration.
color.specialColors: Index 0 is transparent; indices 16..31 remap. No SHP per-index full-bright exemption found. Per-asset LightingType/UseNormalLight/animation palettes remain caller-controlled. Do not import VPL index rules into SHP.

filters.data: nearest only; no interpolated discrete shade index
filters.edgePadding: Extrude boundary RGB/shade into a two-texel gutter with zero alpha and zero remap coverage outside the logical extent; padding excluded from sampleRect.

fallback.unit: entire resolved SHP member including all visible animation frames
fallback.shadowPolicy: Always retain original shadow frames, excluded from required override frames
fallback.aggregatePolicy: Resolve and validate constituent member identities before ShpAggregator; retain frame-index mapping. Mixed constituent densities are allowed only as separate batch pages/materials.
fallback.action: Discard candidate member allocations; try next lower supported density once, else original member for the whole game. Never retry per frame.
fallback.logging: One summary per pack/source/theater/density/reason per game plus count; expose chosen fallback in diagnostics.

shadowAndDepth.depth: Original logical depth split, draw order, occlusion, layer and Z offsets
shadowAndDepth.states: No implicit coverage of damage, buildup, bib, turret, debris or other constituent SHPs.

cache.lifetime: Explicit per-pack ownership and per-material usage counts. Retain referenced textures through game teardown; clear on pack switch or context recovery. No unbounded frame cache.

limits.onLimit: Downshift entire member to 2x if valid, otherwise original; no driver auto-resize. Query actual context caps before upload.

localLoading.routes: Manifest-declared exact /local-hd/<manifest-hash>/<page-id> routes registered by desktop/profile.mjs and served by desktop/protocol.mjs; no arbitrary filesystem URLs.
localLoading.verification: Realpath containment, regular files, no symlinks, sizes and SHA-256 for all declared files before registration; no remote URLs.
localLoading.distribution: Pack artwork/retail derivatives remain ignored local profile data, outside Git, dist and application payloads.

vehicles: Separate VXL/HVA/VPL/part-facing design; this contract does not cover vehicles.
